contract.name: SRIP Product Contract — Phase 0
contract.productPositioning: Relationship Operating System for holding companies, subsidiaries and enterprise relationship teams

protectedFiles.policy: اگر فایل در workspace وجود دارد، hash آن باید با expectedSha256 یکسان باشد؛ نبودن آن در cloneهای معمولی مجاز است چون protected/untracked است.

technicalIdentifiers.replacement: EntityPicker, EntityMultiPicker, semantic builders, labels and deep links

namingConvention.endpoint: UPPERCASE HTTP method + normalized /route with :param placeholders
namingConvention.component: PascalCase for shared UI and kebab-case file names for route components

labelPolicy.technicalLabels: Only in admin, debug, API integration and audit contexts; ordinary users receive semantic labels and EntityPicker/deep links.
labelPolicy.rawJson: Never request or expose as the ordinary mutation surface; use typed forms, preview and evidence.
labelPolicy.uuid: Never request UUID/Prisma ID from an ordinary user; resolve via picker, search or deep link.

visualBaseline.rule: Network route changes require screenshot comparison; the reference file itself is immutable.

typography.family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif
typography.title: 19px/1.1
typography.label: 12px/500

referenceTokens.density: dense network canvas with compact 10-12px labels and 34-40px controls

executive.focus: impact, risk, network and next best action
